occurrences.text: And ye are puffed up, and have not rather mourned, that he that hath done this deed might be taken away from among you.
But them that are without God judgeth. Therefore put away from among yourselves that wicked person.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
